item.text: The module has a misspelled enum reference in pseudonymous tracking, and its tracking methods return before capture finishes. I’ll keep the existing boolean `init` calls compatible while storing privacy state as `Anonymity` and adding the requested enum based methods.

The existing tests call async initialization without awaiting it, so their state checks race with the new lifecycle. I’ve updated those calls and will add cases for missing config, pending initialization, DNT, room IDs, and logout.
